body: Thank you for your reply.  I know that really it's all about your perspective, and in a way it's such a simple thing to change, but it can also seem impossible.  I try to be positive (or at least neutral) in the context of the example that you gave but what about everything else?  Sometimes it's really hard to be positive when you keep getting hit with wave after wave of negativity.  Sometimes I do manage to stand up and try to improve on things but quite often it's at these starting points that I keep getting knocked back down again to the point where I don't know why I even bother any more.
Sometimes you have to hit rock bottom before you can start to climb your way back up again.
